title: ci(node): add the npm release workflow
description: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow and a verification script that publish the Node package to npm from a release tag.

acceptance_criteria.text: The workflow publishes every release tag it accepts, including prereleases, or rejects them before publishing.
The verify script rejects malformed arguments instead of skipping checks.

defects.summary: release: published includes prereleases, but npm rejects publishing a prerelease without --tag, so a tag like node-v1.2.3-beta.1 fails at publish.
When --require-npm has no value, the verify script reads undefined and silently skips the npm version check (comment anchored on the test file).

label_notes: Held out. Unlabeled: an out-of-bounds question and a test refactor nit.
